method: One live comparison call with authored synthetic context and offline retrieval. No production journal access or writes; not a full signed-in flow.
journal: I made one selfish choice and now I keep thinking that must be the whole truth about who I am.

selected.text: To measure you by your smallest deed is to reckon the power of ocean by the frailty of its foam.
selected.reason: This line names exactly what you're describing, treating one small, selfish moment as if it could measure your whole character. It helps you notice that a single foam-like deed doesn't reveal the deeper power and breadth of who you are over time.
